\/\u003E\n\u003Ch3 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\nASEAN \u003C\/h3\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nThe Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN ) is a regional organisation comprising ten Southeast Asian states which promotes intergovernmental cooperation and facilitates economic integration amongst its members.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nThe Association of Southeast Asian Nations, or ASEAN, was established on 8 August 1967 in Bangkok, Thailand, with the signing of the ASEAN Declaration (Bangkok Declaration) by the Founding Fathers of ASEAN, namely Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore and Thailand.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Ch3 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\n\u0026nbsp;SAARC\u003C\/h3\u003E\n\u003Ch3 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\n\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/h3\u003E\nThe South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC) is the regional intergovernmental organization and geopolitical union of nations in South Asia. Its member states include Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Nepal, the Maldives, Pakistan and Sri Lanka.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nSAARC was founded in Dhaka on 8th December, 1985. Its secretariat is based in Kathmandu, Nepal. The organization promotes development of economic and regional integration. It launched the South Asian Free Trade Area in 2006. SAARC maintains permanent diplomatic relations at the United Nations as an observer and has developed links with multilateral entities, including the European Union.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \u003C\/b\u003E8 Aug 1967\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cb\u003ESAARC:\u003C\/b\u003E 8 Dec 1985\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Ch4 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\nMember \/\u003E\n\u003Ch4 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\nRegion \u003C\/h4\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cb\u003EASEAN:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E Southeast Asian\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cb\u003ESAARC: \u003C\/b\u003ESouth Asian\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Ch4 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\n\u0026nbsp;Objectives\u003C\/h4\u003E\n\u003Ch4 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\n\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/h4\u003E\n\u003Cb\u003EASEAN:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E Promotes intergovernmental cooperation and facilitates economic integration\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cb\u003ESAARC: \u003C\/b\u003EPromotes development of economic and regional integration\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Ch4 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\nObligations \u003C\/h4\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cb\u003EASEAN: \u003C\/b\u003EMember states have obligation effectively implement the provisions of the Charter.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cb\u003ESAARC: \u003C\/b\u003ENo such provisions.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Ch4 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\nCommon \/\u003E\n\u003Cb\u003ESAARC: \u003C\/b\u003ENo such provision on SAARC Charter.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Ch4 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\nSummit \u003C\/h4\u003E\n\u003Cbr annually.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Ch4 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\n\u0026nbsp;Decesion Making\u003C\/h4\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cb\u003EASEAN:
